NF.Title: Name Forge
NF.Blurb: Generate names for any genre or culture, fully offline.
NF.SourceUnavailable: This type has no real-name list, so its names are always generated.
NF.Tip.Genre: The setting the names belong to, such as Fantasy, Historical or a game universe.
NF.Tip.Category: Narrows the genre, for example common folk, monstrous races or real-world cultures.
NF.Tip.NameType: What kind of name to make: a race or culture, male or female, or a town.
NF.Tip.Real: Use real names taken from the lists instead of newly invented ones. Only available for people-name types that have a list.
NF.Tip.Full: Add a surname to each name, from the same culture.
NF.Tip.Count: How many names to generate at once, up to 30.
NF.Tip.CreateAs: The actor type used when you click the add button next to a name.
NF.CopyHint: Click a name to copy it
NF.CreateHint: Create an actor with this name
NF.ActorCreateFailed: Could not create the actor. See console for details.
NF.Settings.OnlyGenerateNames.Name: Only Generate Names
NF.Settings.OnlyGenerateNames.Hint: Hide the "Create as" actor-type picker and the per-result actor-creation button, leaving name generation/copying only. Turn off to bring back actor creation.
NF.Settings.ShowDirectoryButton.Name: Show Button in Actors Directory
NF.Settings.ShowDirectoryButton.Hint: Show the Name Forge button at the bottom of the Actors sidebar tab.
